title: Study mode and global presence
content: Stardom University delivers 100% flexible online education. The university lists a global office presence, including a United States office (Stardom University Office, 5th Floor, 1211 K St, Sacramento, CA 95814, USA). Programs are organized into faculties/schools such as Business Administration, IT and Computing, Education, Media and Electronic Publishing, Legal Studies, Arts and Languages, and Islamic Studies.

title: Faculties / Schools at Stardom University
content: Stardom University's academic faculties include: Faculty of Business Administration, Faculty of IT and Computing, Faculty of Education, Faculty of Media and Electronic Publishing, Faculty of Legal Studies, Faculty of Arts and Languages, and Faculty of Islamic Studies. Areas of study across the university include Business Administration, Technology and Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Law, Education, and Media and Digital Communication.

title: Admission requirements vary by study level
content: Admission requirements at Stardom University vary depending on the level of study (undergraduate, master's, or doctorate). For undergraduate (Bachelor's) applicants, published requirements include: a High School Certificate or equivalent, identification documents, and a passport-sized photograph. Master's and doctorate applicants have separate, higher-level requirements described on the same page. Applicants should confirm their exact requirements with an admissions advisor, since specific requirements can vary by program.

title: Documents required to apply, by degree level
content: Required documents for the online application generally include: High School Certificate or equivalent (for Bachelor's applicants), a Bachelor's Degree certificate (for Master's applicants), a Master's Degree certificate (for Doctoral applicants), official Academic Transcripts, a valid Passport or National ID, a recent passport-sized photograph, and an English Language Certificate if applicable to the program.

title: How to apply — process overview
content: The published application process is: (1) complete the online application form at stardomuniversity.edu.eu/apply-en, (2) upload the required documents, (3) submit identification documents, (4) pay the application fee, (5) receive an admission decision, (6) confirm admission by paying the required tuition fees according to the approved payment plan, (7) complete final enrollment (including activation of a university email), and (8) begin the learning journey on the university's digital learning platform. Final admission decisions are made by Stardom University, not by this assistant.

title: Tuition fee structure
content: Stardom University charges tuition per semester. The published flat tuition rate is USD 600 per semester, applying to Bachelor's Programs, Higher Diploma Programs, Master's Programs, and Doctoral (PhD) Programs. Exact per-program totals (e.g. total cost across a full program) should be confirmed with an admissions advisor for the student's specific program and intake.

title: Application fee
content: A one-time, non-refundable application fee is required for all applicants. The published application fee is USD 150 for Master's Degree applicants and USD 150 for Doctoral Degree (PhD) applicants. The exact Bachelor's-level application fee amount was not confirmed in the pages reviewed — confirm with an admissions advisor before quoting a figure to an undergraduate applicant.

title: Scholarships and financial aid
content: Stardom University offers scholarships and tuition support based on one or more criteria: academic achievement, country of residence, and humanitarian circumstances, among others. Eligible applicants may receive tuition discounts of up to 30%, subject to the university's scholarship policies and eligibility criteria at the time of application. Scholarship availability is not guaranteed and should be confirmed with an admissions advisor for the specific intake.

title: Accreditation and recognition
content: Stardom University's published accreditation/recognition page states the university holds accreditation from the Sudanese Ministry of Higher Education and has obtained accreditation from the CPD Certification Service. Country-specific degree recognition and equivalency (i.e. whether a specific country's ministry of education will recognize a Stardom degree) is NOT something this assistant can confirm — that always requires human confirmation from the admissions team, since recognition rules vary by country and change over time.

title: Degree authentication
content: Stardom University states that the integrity and authenticity of academic qualifications are fundamental to its quality assurance and institutional commitments, and it maintains a degree authentication process. Specific authentication procedures (e.g. how a third party verifies a Stardom degree) should be requested from the university's official Degree Authentication page or the Admissions Department directly.

title: International student requirements
content: International applicants are required to submit: academic qualifications, official academic transcripts, a valid passport or national identification, and a recent passport-sized photograph. Because Stardom University's programs are delivered 100% online, country-specific visa requirements generally do not apply in the same way as an in-person program — but any visa-related question from a student should be routed to a human advisor rather than answered definitively by this assistant.

title: Official contact channels
content: Admissions Department: admission@stardomuniversity.edu.eu. Student Affairs Department: affair@stardomuniversity.edu.eu. Finance Department: finance@stardomuniversity.edu.eu. WhatsApp: +90 516 162 1500. United States office: Stardom University Office, 5th Floor, 1211 K St, Sacramento, CA 95814, USA — phone +1 917 730 2050. Direct students to the official Contact page for the current, full list of departments and branches.

content: Stardom University's postgraduate catalog is described as including 47 Master's Degree Programs and 37 Doctoral Degree Programs, spanning faculties such as Business Administration, IT and Computing, Education, Legal Studies, and Media and Electronic Publishing.
